title: The Lions Lay Down Quiet
old_p1: King Darius, the new ruler of Babylon, made a new rule: for thirty days, no one could pray to anyone but the king. Daniel loved Heavenly Father, and he would not stop praying.
He went home, opened his windows toward Jerusalem, his faraway home city, and knelt to pray three times a day, just as he always had.
old_p2: So Daniel was put into a den, a deep cave where lions lived. “The One you always serve will save you,” said King Darius.
The king could not sleep all night. Early in the morning he ran to the den and called. Daniel answered, “Heavenly Father sent His angel and shut the lions’ mouths.” Daniel was not hurt at all.
Heavenly Father kept Daniel safe all night long. Snuggle down, and feel that He watches over you while you sleep.
p1: Some men tricked King Darius into making a new rule. For thirty days, no one could pray to anyone but the king.
But Daniel loved Heavenly Father. He opened his window toward Jerusalem, his faraway home. He knelt and prayed three times a day.
The men told the king. The sad king could not change his rule. Daniel was put down with the lions. The king hoped Heavenly Father would save him.
p2: The king could not sleep. In the morning he hurried back. “Daniel!” he called. Daniel answered, “Heavenly Father sent His angel and shut the lions’ mouths.” Daniel was not hurt!
Daniel kept praying, even when it was hard. Tonight you can kneel and pray, just like Daniel. Heavenly Father watches over you too.
